Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, grant me in it (this day/month) alertness and awareness
And distance me in it from foolishness and deception

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ نَصِيْبًا مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ تُنْزِلُ فِيْهِ
Translation: And grant me a portion of every good that You send down in it
By Your generosity, O Most Generous of the generous ones
